Field Descriptions

marker - csr.status.result.marker[31:0]

Result marker the firmware writes when it stops, e.g. 0x0000FACE for PASS. Unlike tx.data, writing it launches no TLP: the value goes to logic only, to the PASS LED and to an ILA.
